question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
sql:
WITH valid_players AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE) as debut_date,
        TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE) as final_date
    FROM player
    WHERE debut != '' AND debut IS NOT NULL 
        AND final_game != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL
        AND TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
        AND TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
),
date_components AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        DATE_DIFF('day', debut_date, final_date) AS total_days
    FROM valid_players
    WHERE total_days > 0
),
decomposed AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        total_days,
        -- years = total_days / 365 (integer)
        CAST(total_days / 365 AS INTEGER) AS years,
        -- remaining_days after years
        total_days % 365 AS remaining_days,
        -- months = remaining_days / 30.44 (integer)
        CAST(remaining_days / 30.44 AS INTEGER) AS months,
        -- days = remaining_days % 30.44 (integer)
        CAST(remaining_days % 30.44 AS INTEGER) AS days
    FROM date_components
),
career_spans AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        years,
        months,
        days,
        -- Round each part to 2 decimal places before summing
        ROUND(CAST(years AS DOUBLE), 2) AS years_rounded,
        ROUND(CAST(months AS DOUBLE) / 12.0, 2) AS months_part_rounded,
        ROUND(CAST(days AS DOUBLE) / 365.0, 2) AS days_part_rounded,
        -- Sum the rounded parts
        ROUND(CAST(years AS DOUBLE), 2) + ROUND(CAST(months AS DOUBLE) / 12.0, 2) + ROUND(CAST(days AS DOUBLE) / 365.0, 2) AS career_span
    FROM decomposed
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as player_count,
    AVG(career_span) as avg_career_span
FROM career_spans
